title: Autonomous Mission Director — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Converts a high-level objective into a plan, assigns resources, tracks milestones, and handles failures. Given an objective, the director produces a milestone plan, assigns work to available resources, watches progress, and re-plans when steps fail. demo.title: Multi-agent assignment simulation
demo.code: const agents=[{id:'a1',cap:2,load:0},{id:'a2',cap:3,load:0},{id:'a3',cap:2,load:0}];const tasks=[1,2,3,4,5].map(i=>({id:'t'+i,cost:1}));for(const t of tasks){const cands=agents.filter(x=>x.load+t.cost<=x.cap).sort((x,y)=>x.load-y.load);assert(cands.length,'no agent for '+t.id);const a=cands[0];a.load+=t.cost;t.agent=a.id;}assert(agents.every(a=>a.load<=a.cap),'overload');console.log(JSON.stringify({system:TOOL.key,assigned:tasks.length,loads:agents.map(a=>a.load)}));
